verdict.rationale: Recurly's docs describe data import/export tooling that can populate or export large sets of accounts, subscriptions, invoices, coupons, etc., which supports bulk data operations, and its API/client libraries allow programmatic automation across many records. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-operations endpoint (e.g., batch update/cancel of many subscriptions or invoices in one call) or AI-native bulk tooling beyond the general MCP/API access. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints for subscriptions or invoices, documented bulk-edit UI or CLI, and independent evidence of successful large-scale batch operations.
